title: Fog Envelops the Lone Islet
description:
Silken clouds drift; night sky ripples with starlight.Snowflakes dance; branches split moonlight into the woods.Blue grass spreads; soft wind whispers in the quiet valley.Fireflies flicker; sleeping earth begins to murmur.Mist fades; faint light outlines the isle.
Welcome to Misty Isle -
Let’s join the starry feast.
